summary: Fury Gold Mines filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 25, 2026. The press release reports infill drill assay results from its Phase 2 drill program at the Eau Claire Gold Project in Quebec. Highlights include hole 26EC-125 intersecting 14.41 g/t gold over 3.92 m. The program comprises 15,000-25,000 m of drilling aimed at upgrading inferred mineral resources to higher-confidence categories. Approximately 15,047 m across 35 holes was drilled. Results confirm mineralization continuity and support resource conversion objectives, with pre-feasibility targeted for 2027. This is standard operational disclosure with no deal structure, takeover, or special-situation mechanics; it is routine exploration update reporting.
